crossRefs.note: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there…
“ ‘ “Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm…

people.name: Abel-keramim
people.line: A place near Ammon, attacked by Jephthah.

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city in Gad, built by the Gadites.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Minnith
people.line: An Ammonite town known for its wheat

translations.web: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: With a great blow he devastated twenty cities from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel-keramim. So the Ammonites were subdued before the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And he smote them from Aroer until thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
